body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-19 13:40Z, my own miss). After ANY host restart or reboot, walk the WHOLE Termal:: session list from /api/state, not just the lanes in the current queue memory. Wake every lane with its post-restart step: renew or recover the claim, re-name the root if the fence changed, carry onto the new master, refreeze, READY. Assign a ready item to any lane that holds nothing. On 10-19 eleven lanes sat idle for about 65 minutes after the 12:34Z restart because I resumed only the active queue (noted on w-d9f93ea08fd2).
